# Workshop source and learner safety

- This is one sequential four-section/four-step workshop. Keep participant-facing
  **AgentAlvine**, one Exercise and exact `proceed to next section` boundary comments.
- Source-template maintenance and reports publish on **dev only**. Never deploy from
  this source, public repositories, templates or ordinary new private copies.
- Authoring/PR verification is credential-free: Node tests, pinned Terraform
  schemas/provider-mocked operations, links/images and actionlint. No live state,
  Azure login/provisioning, roles, keys or bootstrap without explicit owner authority.
- Preserve scoped OIDC, protected current main, actual required checks, independent
  state/locking, encrypted expiring same-run exact plans and a separate authorized
  cleanup workflow. Issue progression is never Azure authorization.
- Live admission is still only the two exact immutable approved private simulation
  identities in the reviewed authorization helper. Their identity alone does not
  authorize this RG/B1/storage profile, spending or new roles. Keep false until owner
  scope/currency-budget/lifetime/RBAC/backend/private-runner/package controls are ready.
- Do not teach students to modify allowlists, control pins, roles, fingerprints,
  checks or backend. Freeze approved name/001; preserve storage/DNS naming exceptions.
- Keep shared backend/identities/runner outside the owned RG AND deployment authority.
  Before RG destruction reject unrelated/untracked children and preserve nonempty-RG
  safeguards. Cleanup requires its own owner decision, never an ordinary push/comment.
- Keep beginner install/account/private-copy/clone/open instructions, short explanatory
  steps, attributed genuine reference images, expected results and minimal recovery.
- Preserve all historical evidence and other repositories. Never create `.opencode`,
  Graphify, custom Scrum agents or role-team ceremonies for this workshop.
